farkle.name: Farkle
farkle.tagline: Play Farkle online — two players, six dice, one medieval gamble. Create a room, invite a friend, or play solo vs the computer.
farkle.problem: Local Farkle needs a table, dice, and someone who remembers the scoring.
farkle.stack: Realtime rooms on the web, plus a computer opponent for solo play.
farkle.outcome: A live game you can open, share, and finish in a browser.

baklavue.name: BaklaVue
baklavue.tagline: Vue 3 UI kit for Trendyol Baklava — bridges Baklava web components with Vue's reactive ecosystem: type-safe components with v-model, slots, and composables.
baklavue.problem: Baklava ships as web components; Vue apps still want v-model, slots, and types.
baklavue.stack: Vue 3 wrappers, composables, and TypeScript over Baklava.
baklavue.outcome: A documented kit teams can drop into Vue without fighting the native layer.

nestConcept.name: Nest Concept
nestConcept.tagline: Professional architecture, landscape, structure, and construction services. Get in touch for modern, innovative solutions.
nestConcept.problem: A practice site that had to feel like the work: architecture, landscape, structure.
nestConcept.stack: A marketing site with a quiet editorial layout.
nestConcept.outcome: A live studio presence for inquiries and the portfolio of built work.

dontBeAfk.name: Don't Be AFK
dontBeAfk.tagline: Keep your status active and never go idle. Customizable mouse movement and clicks with a global hotkey, startup launch, and daily activity stats.
dontBeAfk.problem: Idle timers drop you AFK when you are still at the desk.
dontBeAfk.stack: A desktop menu-bar app with a global hotkey and daily stats.
dontBeAfk.outcome: One toggle keeps presence alive without babysitting the mouse.

gitPersona.name: Git Persona
gitPersona.tagline: Switch git identities by repository. Named personas with email, name, and signing key, plus a menu bar panel for quick switches.
gitPersona.problem: Work and personal git identities leak across repos.
gitPersona.stack: Named personas (name, email, signing key) from a menu bar.
gitPersona.outcome: Per-repo identity switches without editing git config by hand.

cura.name: Cura
cura.tagline: Switch Cursor accounts without friction. Isolated profiles with their own settings, extensions, and sign-in, launched from the menu bar.
cura.problem: Cursor ties settings, extensions, and sign-in to one profile.
cura.stack: Isolated profiles launched from the menu bar.
cura.outcome: Work and personal Cursor accounts stay apart with a one-click switch.

readMyScreen.name: Read My Screen
readMyScreen.tagline: A Raycast extension that turns screenshots, clipboard images, image files, and the active browser tab into AI-powered explanations, using OpenAI (GPT-4o and more), Anthropic Claude, or Google Gemini.
readMyScreen.problem: A screenshot or tab is faster to capture than to explain.
readMyScreen.stack: A Raycast extension over OpenAI, Claude, or Gemini.
readMyScreen.outcome: Clipboard, files, and the active tab become a readable explanation.

crossingRhine.name: Crossing of the Rhine: A.D. 406
crossingRhine.tagline: A choice-driven historical RPG about the Migration Period. Lead a tribe at Rome's frontier and reshape the Crossing of the Rhine through the decisions you make.
crossingRhine.problem: The Crossing of the Rhine is usually a paragraph in a textbook, not a playable fork.
crossingRhine.stack: A choice-driven historical RPG set on Rome's frontier.
crossingRhine.outcome: A shipped game where tribal decisions rewrite A.D. 406.

spaceflash.name: Spaceflash
spaceflash.tagline: A wave-based VR shooter for Quest and other headsets. Defend your moon base as endless enemies close in, and chase high scores on the board.
spaceflash.problem: A moon-base defense fantasy needed to live in a headset, not a 2D mock.
spaceflash.stack: Wave-based VR shooting for Quest and other headsets.
spaceflash.outcome: A score-chasing defense game you play on the board in VR.
